scoring_justification: Full recompute of Monte Carlo simulation is infeasible in verifier; score transmission probabilities against experimental reference and required relative trend (good models close, Rutherford far).

hidden_assets.purpose: Experimental transmission reference from Seliger for 336 keV e⁻ on 55 mg/cm² Ag
hidden_assets.source_provenance: H.H. Seliger, Phys. Rev. 100, 1029 (1955); measurement reported in the paper (p. 1034, Table I).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from the paper; value = 0.180.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: This is the published experimental measurement the paper's simulation is validated against; it is the authoritative external reference.

outputs.description: Agent-supplied transmission probabilities. The hidden checker compares these against a hidden experimental reference value for the same condition using predefined tolerances.

output_contract.notes: Only the single condition (Ag 55 mg/cm², 336 keV) is scored. The agent must compute and report all three model values.
